prompt: Generate a stone fountain occupying exactly a 2x2 square of 128px cells (256x256 ground footprint), with 128px visible height. Deliver one complete transparent object, with a ground anchor at the center of the 2x2 footprint. Deliver each sprite in a 384x576px frame with local projected ground anchor (192,376). Save original generated images, exact prompts, all references, processed sprites, result.json, and review previews in {{OUTPUT_DIR}}.

visualChecks.projection: Screen-aligned square grid; top and front readable; parallel edges, no depth-dependent scale or camera drift.
visualChecks.complete-art: Full silhouette and effects fit the declared frame; no clipped limbs or undeclared shadows.
visualChecks.anchor-placement: Ground/root location matches the guide independently of alpha bounds or visible toe tips.
visualChecks.multi-cell-size: The base is 256x256 at the shared 128px grid scale; it is not shrunk into a single cell.
visualChecks.multi-cell-overlap: Place on a multi-row grid: the whole fountain extends upward, overlaps correctly, and is never cut into cell-sized raster fragments.
visualChecks.source-faithfulness: Compare original generated sources with processed sprites and declared operations; no invented replacement art or unreported geometry fitting.
